title: The Unsaid Radiators
author: R. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Noor Winterbourne, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
